name: Steamed Baby Bok Choy (Tender Leaf Tops Only, Thick Stalks Removed)
whyItWorks: Tender dark green leafy tops of baby bok choy steamed until soft and silky with a drop of sesame oil. Thick crunchy base stems are trimmed away to minimize insoluble roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Slice off and discard the lower 2 inches of white crunchy stems. Steam only the leafy green blades for 4–5 minutes until completely wilted and tender.
